frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for various frontend files including components, hooks, and config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color variables, dark mode values, and base layout rules.

Canvas animation component generating fireworks particle effects with reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing signature text with name and date.

frontend/src/components/HeartsRain.tsx: Canvas animation creating falling heart shapes with drift, opacity, and reduced‑motion checks.

frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors from CSS variables, fonts, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing goals, constraints, known issues, and required backend actor presence for build success.
